```python
import asyncio
from fastmcp import Server
from fastmcp.client import LocalAsyncClient


async def main():
    # Create server
    server = Server("example-server")

    # Register a resource at data://config
    @server.resource("data://config")
    async def get_config_resource():
        return "Configuration data stored here"

    # Create in-memory client connection
    client = LocalAsyncClient(server)

    # Fetch the resource contents
    resource = await client.read_resource("data://config")
    print(f"Resource contents: {resource.contents}")


asyncio.run(main())
```
